title: Palindrome Checker
description: Return true if the given string is a palindrome. Otherwise, return false, ignoring punctuation, case, and spacing.

approaches.name: Approach 1: String Methods
approaches.description: Clean the string using regex, split into an array, reverse it, and join back to compare.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Two-Pointer Technique
approaches.description: Compare characters from both ends moving inward for O(n/2) time complexity and O(1) extra space.

title: DNA Pairing
description: Take each character, get its pair, and return results as a 2d array.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Hash Map
approaches.description: Using an object lookup map for clean, functional mapping with split() and map().

approaches.name: Approach 2: Switch Case
approaches.description: Iterating through characters using a traditional loop and switch statement.

title: Find the Missing Letter
description: Find the missing letter in the passed letter range and return it. If all letters are present in the range, return undefined.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Alphabet Reference String
approaches.description: Compare characters against a pre-defined alphabet string using indexOf().

approaches.name: Approach 2: Character Codes (charCodeAt)
approaches.description: Check if consecutive ASCII character code values increment strictly by 1.

title: Chunky Monkey
description: Write a function that splits an array (first argument) into groups the length of size (second argument) and returns them as a two-dimensional array.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Splice in a While Loop
approaches.description: Mutates a shallow copy or original array by splicing chunks of size until empty.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Non-mutating Slice Loop
approaches.description: Iterates using a step size (i += size) and extracts immutable chunks with slice().

title: Falsy Bouncer
description: Remove all falsy values from an array. Falsy values in JavaScript are false, null, 0, "", undefined, and NaN.

approaches.name: Approach 1: For Loop & Boolean Constructor
approaches.description: Iterate through elements and push truthy items after checking Boolean(item).

approaches.name: Approach 2: Array Filter Method
approaches.description: Use Array.prototype.filter() passing Boolean directly as the callback function.

title: HTML Entities Converter
description: Convert the characters &, <, >, ", and ' to their corresponding HTML entities.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Map Lookup
approaches.description: Split the string into characters and map each character against an entity dictionary.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Regex Replace
approaches.description: Use string replace with global regex matching special characters against entity lookup.

title: Largest Numbers in Arrays
description: Return an array consisting of the largest number from each provided sub-array.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Nested Loops
approaches.description: Iterate through inner arrays keeping track of maximum values using conditional comparisons.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Array Map & Math.max
approaches.description: Use map() combined with spread syntax inside Math.max() for clean declarative code.

title: Mutation Checker
description: Return true if the string in the first element of the array contains all of the letters of the string in the second element of the array.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Iterative Includes Check
approaches.description: Loop through each character in the target string and return false if missing in target string.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Array Every Method
approaches.description: Convert string to array and check if every character passes the includes test.

title: Reverse a String
description: Reverse the provided string and return the reversed string.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Backward Loop
approaches.description: Iterate backwards from string end, pushing characters to an array and joining.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Built-in Methods
approaches.description: Chain split(), reverse(), and join() for concise single-line string reversal.

title: Finders Keepers
description: Create a function that looks through an array and returns the first element in it that passes a truth test.

approaches.name: Approach 1: For...of Loop
approaches.description: Iterate through elements and return the first element where test predicate yields true.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Array Find Method
approaches.description: Use JavaScript's native Array.prototype.find() method.

title: Sum All Numbers in a Range
description: We'll pass you an array of two numbers. Return the sum of those two numbers plus the sum of all the numbers between them.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Functional Range & Reduce
approaches.description: Generate range using Array.from() and accumulate total sum with reduce().

approaches.name: Approach 2: Gauss Formula (Math O(1))
approaches.description: Use Arithmetic Progression Sum Formula: sum = n * (min + max) / 2.

title: Sorted Union
description: Write a function that takes two or more arrays and returns a new array of unique values in the order of the original provided arrays.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Flat & Set
approaches.description: Flatten arguments array with flat() and filter duplicates instantly using Set.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Reduce & Includes
approaches.description: Flatten arrays and reduce down into unique collection by checking includes().

title: Title Case a Sentence
description: Return the provided string with the first letter of each word capitalized. Make sure the rest of the word is in lower case.

approaches.name: Approach 1: String Splitting & Loop
approaches.description: Normalize case, split into words, capitalize charAt(0), slice remaining letters, and join.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Map Transformation
approaches.description: Chain split(), map(), and join() for clean functional formatting.

title: Slice and Splice
description: Copy each element of the first array into the second array, in order, beginning at the specified index index.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Spread & Splice
approaches.description: Create a shallow copy of target array and insert array elements into position using spread syntax.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Array Slicing
approaches.description: Slice target array into two halves at insertion index and sandwich source array in between.

title: Find the Longest Word in a String
description: Return the length of the longest word in the provided sentence.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Loop Comparison
approaches.description: Split sentence by spaces and track maximum word length found during iteration.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Reduce Method
approaches.description: Use reduce() to compare adjacent lengths and return maximum length encountered.
